status: Bounded geometry survey, not a global optimisation
projection_rule: L sin(abs(theta)) + t cos(theta) = 75 mm; every row has the same projected interval in a 300 mm period
manufacturing: Lengths, thicknesses and beam centre locations use 5 mm increments. Angles are derived continuously to retain exactly 75% ideal clear frontal view. Derived corner coordinates are not stock-cut dimensions.
limitations: Normal-incidence periodic rigid lossless 2D model, not a finite 9.9 m wall
Stair-step approximation of inclined boundaries; numerical opening can be slightly larger than the exact geometric opening
Three points per band for screening; dominant bands refined to 33 for finalists
High-frequency weak bands have limited spatial resolution
No grounds, supports, vertical-height effects, damping or structural design
